points.label: GO stations inside Markham
points.body: The Stouffville line runs the length of the city, so most neighbourhoods sit within a short drive of a train to Union Station.

points.label: Unionville GO to Union Station
points.body: Scheduled weekday train time, not a drive estimate. Use the posted timetable, not an average.
points.source: Verify against the current GO Transit schedule

points.label: Public school boards
points.body: York Region District School Board and York Catholic District School Board both serve Markham and boundaries are reviewed periodically. Always confirm the catchment for a specific address before you buy.

points.label: Community centres and libraries
points.body: City run recreation and library branches are spread across the neighbourhoods rather than concentrated in one core.
points.source: Verify against the City of Markham facility list
